name: vecline
description: Local-first image-to-SVG + PDF/Office toolkit that measures its own output. Nothing uploaded.
long_description:
Vecline converts images to vector and documents to images **entirely on your machine** — nothing is uploaded to any service.

It is unusual in one specific way: it **measures its own output**. After a conversion it renders the SVG it just produced back to pixels and scores it against your source with real SSIM, PSNR and CIEDE2000, so an agent can see how good a result actually is instead of taking the tool's word for it. On flat artwork — logos, icons, screenshots, pixel art — it produces vector geometry that rasterises back **bit-exact**, and says so.

It also covers the parts most vectorisers skip: centreline (single-stroke) tracing plus DXF, EPS, PDF and G-code export for laser cutters, plotters and CNC; perceptual image diffing; content-aware cropping; and rendering PDF and Office documents to images.

Honest limitation: this is a deterministic, classical tracer, not a neural one. On difficult photographs a trained model will still produce cleaner shapes. What you get instead is reproducibility (identical input, identical output, forever), privacy, and numbers you can check.

soffice_path.title: LibreOffice binary (optional)
soffice_path.description: Only needed for the Office conversion tools. Leave empty to auto-detect. Without LibreOffice those tools report themselves as unavailable; everything else works normally.

tools.name: vectorize
tools.description: Convert a raster image to SVG, auto-selecting pixel-exact or traced output.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert between formats by extension, including DXF, EPS and PDF vector export.

tools.name: centerline
tools.description: Trace line art to single-stroke centreline SVG, or straight to G-code.

tools.name: measure
tools.description: Score two images against each other: PSNR, SSIM, CIEDE2000, and whether they are pixel-identical.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Paint a perceptual CIEDE2000 heatmap of what changed between two images.

tools.name: crop
tools.description: Content-aware crop to an aspect ratio, keeping the subject rather than the centre.

tools.name: doc_to_images
tools.description: Render a PDF, SVG or Office document to one image per page.

tools.name: office_convert
tools.description: Convert Office documents to and from PDF using a local LibreOffice.

tools.name: images_to_pdf
tools.description: Combine images into a single multi-page PDF.

tools.name: palette
tools.description: Extract a perceptual dominant-colour palette from an image.

tools.name: placeholder
tools.description: Generate a BlurHash string for lazy-loading an image.

tools.name: image_info
tools.description: Inspect an image: dimensions, format, alpha and recommended strategy.
